subject: test-automation
reason: All nine cases are implemented with their exact inputs, buyer ids, setup and value assertions. Eight run as functional tests against the real Redis repository (TC-BUG-33-01 also reads Redis directly), and the e2e test TC-BUG-33-07 calls real gRPC with bob's implicit-flow token and checks every listed cart element. Its keyframes show one Wanderer Black Hiking Boots line at quantity 3, $329.97, badge 3, and the style checks found nothing.
